title: Making money in your 20s - 7 Ways | #AajWithRaj Ep 09 | Passive Income ideas for your 20s
text: You must have heard everywhere that If you want to a lot of money  then you would need to earn it through 2 or 3 ways infact 4-5 ways  because one income stream is not enough to earn you a  fortune and to make you a millionaire or billionaire. But has anyone told you that these 5-6-7 different streams of income how do you build these sources, how do you earn  through these many methods, what shall you do? Well, I also cant tell you this but what I can tell you is today I’m 24  and I have 7 different sources of Income. I can tell you what I did and for all of these  I did only one thing. By focussing on only one thing how did I built 7 streams of income. Number 1 : Consultancy  Now, what is Consultancy? It is you telling people about things that  (i) They don’t know about or  (ii) They have less knowledge about and with that knowledge you will help them which will (iii) Benefit them in some way. Now only for this thing many big companies hire reputed and big consultants .  So I was a kid I was 17years old, what can I teach at 17years old that big companies will  hire me and pay me for?  So at that time I was thinking this so I went to my father  and asked him What shall I do that world will know value tell me some 3-4 things that I can do which will increase my value so he said that “Don’t Run Behind 3-4 Things” Just find 1  thing and learn it with so much depth that you become an expert in it and when you will  become an expert then people will regard you as a high-value person, you will be valued a  lot more and then you can think of how you can earn money and which companies you can  consult or what you can do in own company. I found that enlightening. I went on to google and searched what skills will earn me a lot of money  because that’s what I wanted to do  but I found nothing then I googled something that every kid who is about to go in college  searches about What should be my degree? What shall I read about? What colleges will be good  for me? So at that time instead of this I searched about Which Skill Would be in Most Demand  in the Future? then I got to know online marketing, digital marketing their demands are going to soar and people don’t know much about it, I thought this is good I called some of my friends talked to them and realised no one knew about it so I went back to google  and looked up Where Can I Learn Digital Marketing From? and came to know that google itself gives Free Certificate courses that you can learn digital marketing in detail, so I learnt it I didn’t learnt all of it but learnt one specific thing which was Google Ad are run  then I learnt how Facebook ads are run and now when I learnt these 2 things  I had learnt something which many people didn’t know even in my friend circle.  One of my friends dad worked in Jaguar-LandRover so I went to him and asked whether  I will get an internship in your company, he said No you’re small you would need to apply  I said to him Tell me your problems which I can solve so he told me his problem is not in  the company his real problem is the local dealership, those who sell cars, we need to run  ads about the dealership everywhere and their budget was low, they wanted to run ads so that  people will get to know that now the Jaguar LandRover is here and with this person  so that everyone would get to know where Jaguars are sold, so I asked them their budget  he quoted me a number I told him what if in half the budget I will make everyone know that your franchise or your dealership is at this place I can do this by running ads he scolded me don’t do this non-sense but I said if I do it you will give me 25K rupees because  I was saving them 2Lakhs from their whole budget so I said I will save you 2 Lakhs just give 25K to me he said OK and then I told him about Social Media Marketing and running ads on google and Facebook and then because of those ads many people got to know about the  dealership and this was my 1st project of Consultancy since then I have consulted with my  companies about how to grow on social media, how to sell their products and how to run ads and that has become one of my income streams how much do I Invest?
